description: 中央管水門 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 資料來源為經濟部水利署104年辦理「中央管水門及抽水站資料庫建置計畫」,計畫範圍涵蓋全省中央管河川、區域排水及海堤水門,透過蒐集處理歷年水利建造物、水門資料卡、河川局水門維護廠商書圖報告等資料蒐集,歸納整理水門總數共計3957座,配合現有水門資料之蒐集與記錄,採現地調查方式,進行定位,坐標為TWD97【2010】坐標系統。 屬性資料建置依... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
